chapter 7 Is Food Your Frenemy? 
activity 48 practicing gratitude
for you to know
Another important tool to help you manage life’s difficulties is gratitude. People often spend lots 
of time focused on what others have that they don’t have and on feeling the despair of their depri-
vation. If you can flip this focus and look for the things in your life that you appreciate, you’ll find 
that your mood will switch, and your need to use eating as a way to cope will shrink away.
for you to do
In the chart that follows, you’ll find some things to put on a gratitude list. Mark the ones that fit 
for you and then add any others:
I am grateful for:
Yes or No
My family
My friends
My pets
My significant other
My health
My education
